title: Metallic vs Roughness Sphere Chart
description: Canonical PBR test rig: a 7×7 grid of spheres sharing one base colour. Roughness varies left → right (mirror at 0 → diffuse at 1); metallic varies bottom → top (dielectric at 0 → metal at 1). Lit by the renderer's procedural sky cubemap + directional sun, so each cell shows how the Cook-Torrance BRDF + GGX prefiltered cubemap responds to the (metallic, roughness) pair.
